name: Festival Asterisco
description: Immerse yourself in the world of performance and live art. This city-wide festival brings thought-provoking and innovative works to unexpected spaces.
longDescription:
Festival Asterisco is an annual city-wide art festival dedicated to performance and live art, taking place across various venues in Porto from July 3rd to July 5th, 2026. The festival aims to showcase contemporary artistic practices that challenge traditional forms and engage with urban spaces, presenting works that often blur the lines between art and everyday life. It serves as a platform for both established and emerging artists to present experimental and site-specific pieces.

Attendees can expect to encounter a diverse range of performances, from solo acts to collaborative installations, presented in both conventional and unconventional settings throughout Porto. The atmosphere is generally exploratory and reflective, attracting an audience interested in contemporary art and experimental forms. Works are typically presented in a variety of durations, and the festival encourages engagement with the city's architectural and social fabric.

Ticket prices for Festival Asterisco vary depending on the specific event or performance. Information regarding individual event ticketing and venue locations will be released closer to the festival dates. Porto's public transport network, including metro, bus, and tram, provides access to most central areas where venues are likely to be situated.
